verdict.rationale: Conductor's core purpose is delegating tasks to AI coding agents inside the app. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode run in parallel, each with its own workspace, branch, terminal and diff review, plus model switching, routines, checkpoints and agents that configure the environment autonomously. Community users confirm it wraps a local Claude Code installation via the SDK. The deduction is because the assistant is not a first-party agent: users must bring their own third-party agent subscriptions or keys, and delegation is scoped to coding work. Missing for 10: a native first-party assistant that works without external agent subscriptions, and delegation beyond coding tasks.
